name: Speedcube Saturday Rialto 2023
information:
Welcome to SpeedCube Saturday: The Ultimate Cubing Competition series in the Inland Empire, California! Join us for high-quality cubing, friendly competition, and exciting record-breaking speeds. Stay tuned for our cubing merchandise line in the future!

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBaWcvIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--66fa7e24b6d93bad203dfc6a97edfbb11c22fdf1/logo%20jpg%20black%20background.jpg)

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZzB5IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--c648f1c37642837bd6ec7ced2a03e220352f5fbb/wcc-banner.png)

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [New Competitors tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SpeedcubeSaturdayRialto2023#28330-new-competitor-information-and-faq).
